keyFindings.description: Requester.Service's doc comment still states the retired rule: set only when the pod's verified account 'is the one BROKER_SERVICES binds that service to'. Plan D6/task F put every passage that states the one-account rule in scope because no machine check reaches them; this one, on the field that carries the authorization decision, was missed. Rewrite to 'one of the accounts BROKER_SERVICES maps to that service'.

Plan D10's run record: the older bullet still says, 'at this change's head', that get/list/create services answer 'no', while the new bullet at :2805 records them 'yes' on 2026-10-25. Date or qualify the older bullet ('at the time of that run') as the second bullet already does, so the record reads as one history rather than a contradiction.

The tester's test copies the HTTP call, JSON decode, token login, pod enrollment, signed request and response type of service_accounts_test.go:73-190. Factor one test-only fixture in a new file shared by the two tests (not service_login_test.go, so the overlap with #2162 does not widen); keep both tests' cases and the real-binary boundary.

verified: Production code: requester's guarded subject lookup (machine_state.go:214), Load's account-keyed map and direct overlap lookup (config.go:399-411), the same-service duplicate wording (config.go:221-225), loader's distinct services (main.go:133); all four requester call sites pass ServicesByAccount; no reader of the old ServiceAccounts field remains in packages/envoy or packages/daemon.

Sibling boundaries held by tests that fail when broken: unlisted account (service_accounts_test.go pod C; machine_test.go impostor), account listed for another service under a different launcher (service_account_scope_test.go, the tester's mutant), account dropped from the configuration (TestAServiceGrantStopsWhenItsServiceAccountChanges, inverted so its old subject is gone), session-kind and launcher-less pods (TestAServicesSecretGoesToItsOwnPodsAlone).
No contract change census needed: the change adds no refusal and removes or renames nothing at a process or package boundary; BROKER_SERVICES widens and the renamed fields are in internal packages.
Both E2E lines present with surface, command, observation, head and negative control; tester verified the implementer's proof.
